title: United Bengal Proposal
subtitle: A late attempt to avoid partition through sovereign Bengal.
summary: In 1947, political leaders advanced a United Bengal proposal to preserve Bengal as an undivided political unit, but the plan failed amid all-India partition negotiations and communal polarization.
heroTagline: A late attempt to avoid partition through sovereign Bengal.
whyItMatters: The proposal reveals alternative constitutional futures that were considered but politically outmatched at partition.
